info.title: Social Bot Hunter API
info.description: Production-oriented investigation API for cross-platform bot-risk assessment and coordinated-network detection with transparent evidence, provenance, and role-based access control.

post.description: Authenticate with JSON payload containing username and password.
Authenticate via OAuth2 Password Grant Form (used by OpenAPI / Swagger UI).
Rotate refresh token and issue a fresh access and refresh token pair.
Revoke the current access token and optionally an associated refresh token.

get.description: Return the profile and role of the currently authenticated user.
List users in the system (Admin only).

post.description: Create a new user account (Admin only).

get.description: Get a user by ID (Admin or self).

patch.description: Update user attributes (Admin or self). Non-admins cannot alter role or is_active.

delete.description: Delete a user account (Admin only). Users cannot delete their own account.

get.description: Query system audit events (Auditors and Admins only).

get.description: Get single audit event details (Auditors and Admins only).
List official platform capabilities, permission scopes, and verified endpoints.
List capabilities for a specific social media platform.
List investigation scans ordered by creation date.
Get metadata and current status for a specific scan.

delete.description: Permanently delete a scan and all associated records (Admin only).

get.description: Generate or retrieve the consolidated risk and cluster report for a scan.
Compare relationship structures between two scans with coverage-aware diffing.
List account risk assessments for a scan with optional band and status filtering.
Retrieve detailed assessment, features, and profile observations for an account.
Retrieve all concrete evidence records supporting an account's risk score.
Retrieve detected coordinated clusters for a scan.
Generate directed graph elements formatted for Cytoscape.js visualization.

post.description: Generate and ingest a deterministic synthetic dataset for pipeline validation (Investigator/Admin only).
Import a local verified dataset directory into the investigation pipeline (Investigator/Admin only).
